QuestInfo.name: Protective Shield Patrol
QuestInfo.0: #p3000000# and the other knights are busy preparing for Magnus's invasion. It seems like\r\n#p3000000# wants to talk to you about something.
QuestInfo.1: #p3000000# asks you to patrol around the Protective Shields while they are preparing countermeasures. He says they are not going to launch the attack yet, but you still have a bad feeling about this. First, go to the Protective Shield at #b#m400010200##k which is close to Heliseum, the home of Magnus.
QuestInfo.2: Although it was only the preliminary attack using trained animals, Magnus's attack came faster than expected. This just means that the real attack will be here soon.

0.0: I don't think Magnus is going to attack soon, but we can't afford to let anything happen to the Protective Shield.

yes.0: You want to head to east first? I see. That side is the closest to Heliseum, where Magnus resides. I suppose it's a good idea to check there first.

no.0: You must be busy at the moment. Let me know when you have time.

1.0: Magnus launched his attack already? Well, we're doomed.

yes.0: This is much sooner than I expected. We're not ready...

default.0:
Why haven't you left yet? If you say you're going to head to #b#m400010200##k, do it!
